name: Blood-Bonded (S-Class Veritus Champion Sanguine Bond)
body:
The blood-bonded are veritus champions that form a strong attachment to their blood dolls. This allows them to create more powerful companions from their blood debt who can fight alongside them.

Sanguine Companion (Ex)

At 4th level, a blood-bonded veritus champion can choose one of his blood dolls when he performs his ritual and dedicate 2 hit points per veritus champion level to it. When he does, that blood doll becomes a sanguine companion until it bursts or the blood-bonded sacrifices it during another ritual. While his sanguine companion exists, the blood-bonded can’t regain his dedicated hit points by any means.

A sanguine companion functions as an unchained summoner’s eidolon that gains 1 evolution point at 4th level and every even level thereafter. Sample evolutions can be found here for a serpentine sanguine companion.

This ability replaces blood magic.

Astral Sanguine Companion Serpentine

N Medium outsider (extraplanar) Init +3; Senses darkvision; Perception +4; AC 15, touch 13, flat-footed 12; (+3 Dex, +2 natural) hp 11 (1d10+1) Fort +3, Ref +5, Will +2; +4 vs. curses, diseases, and poisons; Immune aging; Speed 20 ft., climb 20 ft. Melee bite +2 (1d6+1), tail –3 (1d6) Str 12, Dex 16, Con 13, Int 7, Wis 10, Cha 11; Base Atk +1; CMB +2; CMD 15 (can’t be tripped) Feats Great Fortitude Skills Acrobatic +7, Climb +9, Knowledge (planes) +2, Stealth +7 Languages as summoner; SQ link

Ability Details

Grab (Ex, 2 points): The sanguine companion gains a +4 bonus on combat maneuver checks to grapple. Whenever its bite attack hits a smaller target, it can attempt a free combat maneuver check to grapple that creature.

Link (Ex) The champion and his sanguine companion can communicate telepathically anywhere on the same plane. They share item slots, with the summoner’s taking priority.

Improved Damage (Ex, 1 point): Select one natural attack and increase the damage die by one step (d3, d4, d6, d8, 2d6). This evolution can be selected more than once. Its effects do not stack. Each time the sanguine companion selects this evolution, it applies to a different natural attack.

Improved Natural Armor (Ex, 1 point): The sanguine companion increases its natural armor bonus by +2. This evolution can be taken once, plus one additional time for every 5 levels the summoner possesses. Each additional time it’s taken, the bonus increases by +2.

Large (Ex, 4 points): Prerequisite– 8th level. The sanguine companion becomes Large and gains +4 Strength, +2 Constitution, +2 natural armor, and –2 Dexterity. These are size bonuses. This also increases the sanguine companion’s natural attack damage by one size category (d3, d4, d6, d8, 2d6).

Magic Attacks (Su, 1 point): The sanguine companion’s natural attacks count as magic for the purpose of overcoming Damage Reduction. If the summoner is 10th level or higher, all of the sanguine companion’s natural attacks are treated as the summoner’s alignment for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction.

Mount (Ex, 1 point): The sanguine companion is properly skilled and formed to serve as a combat-trained mount. The sanguine companion must be at least one size category larger than its rider.

See in Darkness (Su, 3 points): Prerequisite– 9th level. The sanguine companion can see perfectly in darkness of any kind, including that created by deeper darkness.

Swallow Whole (Ex, 3 points): Prerequisite– 9th level. If the sanguine companion begins its turn with a smaller creature grappled using its bite attack, it can attempt a combat maneuver check to swallow the creature. Swallowed creatures automatically take an amount of bludgeoning damage equal to 1d6 + the sanguine companion’s bite damage each round. A swallowed creature keeps the grappled condition, but can attempt to cut its way free with a light piercing or slashing weapon. The amount of damage needed to cut free is equal to 1/10 the sanguine companion’s total hit points. The sanguine companion’s AC against these attacks is equal to 10 + 1/2 its natural armor bonus. If a swallowed creature cuts its way out, the sanguine companion loses this ability until it heals this damage. Alternatively, the swallowed creature can attempt to escape the grapple as normal. Success indicates that it has returned to the sanguine companion’s mouth, where it can attempt to escape or can be swallowed again.

Maker’s Call (Su)

At 6th level, once per day, a blood-bonded veritus champion can call his sanguine companion to his side as a standard action. This functions as dimension door, using the summoner’s caster level. When used, the sanguine companion appears adjacent to the summoner (or as close as possible if all adjacent spaces are occupied). If the sanguine companion is out of range, the ability is wasted. The summoner can use this ability once per day at 6th level, plus one additional time per day at 12th level.

This ability replaces waves of blood.

Shield Ally (Su)

At 8th level, whenever a blood-bonded veritus champion is within his sanguine companion’s reach, he receives a +2 shield bonus to his Armor Class and a +2 circumstance bonus on his saving throws. This bonus does not apply if the sanguine companion is grappled, helpless, paralyzed, stunned, or unconscious.

This ability replaces sanguine step.

Transposition (Su)

At 10th level, a blood-bonded veritus champion can use his maker’s call ability to swap locations with his sanguine companion. If it is larger than him, he can appear in any square occupied by the sanguine companion. The sanguine companion must occupy the square that was occupied by the summoner if able, or as close as possible if it is not able.

This ability replaces blood possession.
